_meta.name: spe1_isothermal
_meta.description: Isothermal SPE1 black-oil physics with 5001-point OBL grid (1-450 bar). Self-contained for set_physics — BlackOil builds its full evaluator stack (densities, viscosities, rel-perms, capillary pressures, rock compaction) from the PVT data file at construction time, so no property_regions block is needed at the JSON layer. The caller must override pvt_path with the path to their PVT data file (relative paths resolve against the ModelSpec JSON's directory). components/phases are shipped so callers don't need to repeat them.
references: Odeh (1981) — SPE 9723, SPE Comparative Solution Project (SPE1)
